behaviors.description: A pull request that adds clean lines to a test file holding old defects passes the gate with zero gating findings, and its report names no finding on a line the pull request did not touch.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Reviewing the beside-old fixture exits 0 with recommendation Approve and an empty findings array.

behaviors.description: A defect the pull request introduces fails the gate (exit 1), with a gating finding located on the added line.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Reviewing the adds-defects fixture exits 1, recommends Request Changes or Block, and carries a gating H1 finding inside an added hard-wait test.

behaviors.description: A test function the pull request adds is classified as introduced, whether the review runs on the head commit or on the merge commit.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: No finding on an added line of the adds-defects (head) or merge-review (merge) fixture is pre_existing, and each carries a gating finding on its added lines.

behaviors.description: New setup that makes an unchanged assertion ineffective is a gating finding located on the changed setup line.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Reviewing the setup-change fixture exits 1 with a gating finding.

behaviors.description: Two distinct defects under one registry row stay two findings, each with its own title and location.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The adds-defects review carries one H1 finding inside each of the two hard-wait tests.

behaviors.description: A parameter-driven branch that asserts the expected value on every path is not a High finding. An assertion chosen by control flow over the system output is High.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The adds-defects review carries an H3 finding in the output-selected test and no High or Critical finding in the redundant-branch test.

behaviors.description: A type-assignability test in a repository whose CI runs a type checker is not a High value-assertion finding. A value test that accepts every wrong value of the right shape is High.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The adds-defects review carries an H10 finding in the shape-only test and no High or Critical finding in the covariance test.

behaviors.description: Criteria that do not apply to the repository are absent from the verdict, and wall-clock duration is reported as not measured when nothing executed the tests.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The full-file review of a Python repository carries no finding under a Playwright-utils or Pact row.

behaviors.description: An explicit full-file review (--files) reports every seeded old defect and names its mode as full-file. A pull request review names its mode as pr.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The full-file review carries a finding inside each of the twelve seeded tests and reviewMode full-file; the beside-old review carries reviewMode pr.

oracles.commentary: A pull request that adds one clean test next to old defects passes the gate, and its verdict carries no finding at all: every old defect sits on a line the pull request did not touch.

direction.scope: The exit code, recommendation and findings array of the beside-old review.
direction.negativeDomain: A failing exit, a recommendation other than Approve, or any finding, including a pre-existing one reported as advisory.

oracles.commentary: Hard waits the pull request adds fail the gate: the review exits 1 and a gating H1 finding sits on an added line.

direction.scope: The exit code, recommendation and findings array of the adds-defects review.
direction.negativeDomain: A passing exit, a passing recommendation, or no gating H1 finding inside the added hard-wait tests.

oracles.commentary: Test functions the pull request adds to an existing file are introduced, reviewed on the branch tip and on the merge commit: no finding on an added line is pre-existing, and each review has a gating finding there.

direction.scope: The findings arrays of the adds-defects (head) and merge-review (merge) reviews, with the merge review exit code and recommendation.
direction.negativeDomain: A finding on an added line classified pre_existing, or a review with no gating finding on its added lines.

oracles.commentary: A changed setup line that turns an unchanged assertion into a self-comparison is a pull request regression: the review exits 1 with a gating finding.

direction.scope: The exit code, recommendation and findings array of the setup-change review.
direction.negativeDomain: A passing exit, a passing recommendation, or no gating finding, including the case where the only finding sits on the unchanged assertion and is classified pre-existing.

oracles.commentary: Two hard waits in two added tests stay two H1 findings, one located in each test.

direction.scope: The recommendation and findings array of the adds-defects review.
direction.negativeDomain: One H1 finding covering both tests, or an H1 finding missing from either test.

oracles.commentary: H3 is High for an assertion chosen by control flow over the system output, and no High or Critical finding sits on the parameter-driven branch that asserts the expected value on every path.

direction.scope: The recommendation and findings array of the adds-defects review.
direction.negativeDomain: No H3 finding in the output-selected test, or a High or Critical finding inside the redundant-branch test.

oracles.commentary: H10 is High for a value test that accepts any non-null total, and no High or Critical finding sits on the covariance test, whose assignment the repository CI type-checks with mypy.

direction.scope: The recommendation and findings array of the adds-defects review.
direction.negativeDomain: No H10 finding in the shape-only test, or a High or Critical finding inside the covariance test.

oracles.commentary: A Python repository with neither Playwright nor Pact gets no finding under a Playwright-utils or Pact row.

direction.scope: The recommendation and findings array of the full-file review.
direction.negativeDomain: Any finding under M9, L9, M10, H6, H7, H8 or L4.

oracles.commentary: A full-file review reports every one of the twelve seeded defects, each by a finding inside its own test, and names its mode full-file; a pull request review names its mode pr.

direction.scope: The recommendation, reviewMode and findings array of the full-file review, and the recommendation and reviewMode of the beside-old review.
direction.negativeDomain: A seeded defect with no finding inside its test, a full-file review not named full-file, or a pull request review not named pr.

testData.setup: Nothing is staged by hand: tea-evaluate makes a disposable worktree of this repository and provisions _bmad/ and node_modules/; each step builds its own temporary git repository from a committed synthetic fixture under test/fixtures/test-review-evaluation/repos/ and reviews it there.
testData.cleanup: The fixture wrapper removes its temporary repository when the review ends, and tea-evaluate removes every workspace when the run ends.

safetyLimits: Every fixture is synthetic: no adopter code, report text or repository name appears in it.
Live legs run through the local Claude Code CLI on the owner's subscription, with no API key and no metered spend.
requiredEvidence: The exit code and the verdict JSON on stdout of every review.
Mutation manifestation and rollback evidence for every seeded probe.
